senses.gloss: m. (אנש, sec. r. of אוּשׁ; h. being, esp. human being Dan. II, 10, a. fr. אנש.—
units: <cite ref="Daniel 7:13">Ib. VII, 13</cite> <cite ref="A02006"><he>בר א׳</he></cite> son of man (in Talm. freq. <he>בר נש</he>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 13:2">Targ. O. Lev. XIII, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 8:2:3">Y. Snh. VIII, 25ᵃ</cite> bot., a. fr. <he>כאי׳ דמר</he> as if one says.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 8:2:13">Y. Ber. VIII, 12ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אֲנָשָׁא רבא</he> a great man.
Targ. O. Gen. VI, 4; a. e.—אִינְשִׁין, אִינְשֵׁי. Targ. Y. ibid.; a. e.—In Talm. mostly אִינְשֵׁי people.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b:7">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>אמרי א׳</he> (text <he>רבנן</he>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 95b:11">Snh. 95ᵇ</cite> <he>היינו דאמרי א׳</he> (abbr. <he>ה״דא״א</he>) this is what people say, it is a common saying (proverb).
